newsitem.title: USA: Motorola in deal with China postal service.
newsitem.headline: Motorola in deal with China postal service.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Monday its advanced messaging group signed an agreement with the Posts and Telecommunications Administration of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of China.
The company said the agreement was for installation of a FLEX multi-frequency roaming network supported by Motorola's wireless messaging system.
The Guangxi PTA will use the FLEX protocol-based platform to expand the coverage of its paging network and develop a number of services and businesses.
In a written statement, the company referred to the agreement as a "multi-million dollar contract." The company was not immediately available to provide details.
The company said the paging equipment it provided is ready to be linked to China's roaming paging network.
In addition to the infrastructure, Motorola will offer technical support and long-term assistance as part of the contract.
